scope: Encoding is compression, not a privacy mechanism. All implemented formats disclose the same exact semantic node set under a stable root.

schemes.coordinates: exact individual nodes via level-major ordinals
schemes.trimmed-bitmap: dense possession bitmap with trailing empty bytes omitted
schemes.ranges: exact range possession, not coarse subtree possession
schemes.hybrid: exact node possession plus deterministic selected mode

potential_leakage.previously_visited_leaves: possible inference, not certainty: leaf hashes also enter as siblings
potential_leakage.client_history: partial cache-limited history; repeated snapshots reveal transitions

security: Advertisements express claims only. Hashes stay local; every MTP2 reconstruction must reach the externally trusted root.
warning: All compact schemes can save bytes while retaining exact history leakage. None provides privacy improvement over PCA1.
